01e0562426e41bd00567df472c3d9fe7f82cfb62.summary: Mandiant's overview of named APT groups and threat actors. Most carry a suspected state attribution, mainly China, Iran, North Korea, Russia or Vietnam. Entries list target sectors, malware and initial access methods, often spear phishing. Examples: APT1, suspected to be PLA Unit 61398, stole data from at least 141 organizations; APT38, described as a North Korean regime-backed group, is credited with the largest observed cyber heists. It is a reference list, not one incident report.
